**Having issues or suggestions? Head on over to the [RCLootCouncil Discord server](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=http%253a%252f%252fdiscord.rclootcouncil.com%252f) !**  
For bug reports you can alternatively [use the Curse issue tracking](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil/issues/create) [](https://wow.curseforge.com/projects/rclootcouncil/issues/create) or if you're on [Github](https://github.com/evil-morfar/RCLootCouncil2/issues) that's even better! I much prefer to keep all of it on Discord though.

## WoW Classic

Head over to the [**RCLootCouncil Classic**](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil-classic/) page for more info.

## Modules

* [RCLootCouncil - GroupGear](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil-groupgear)
* [RCLootCouncil - ExtraUtilities](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil-extrautilities)

## 3rd Party Modules

* [RCLootCouncil - Merit](https://www.curseforge.
com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil-merit) by [figure8strat](https://www.curseforge.com/members/figure8strat/projects) _(Retail only)_
* [EPGP - RCLootCouncil Extension](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/epgp-rclootcouncil-extension) by [rocket\_23](https://www.curseforge.com/members/gt_rocket/projects) _( [Retail](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/epgp-rclootcouncil-extension) | [Classic](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/epgp-classic-rclootcouncil-extension) )_

## Group Loot

From Dragonflight Blizzard changed raid looting to group loot only. RCLootCouncil handles this (when enabled) by having the group leader automatically need/greed and everyone else pass on loot.

The caveat here is everyone must have RCLootCouncil installed and enabled for this to work - otherwise someone else may end up with the loot. If for whatever reason people see the default Blizzard loot roll window (where they roll need/greed/pass) they should just pass and check their settings.

...

If the packaged solution doesn't fit your needs there's a lot of different options in the Options menu to play with, and new possibilities is just a request away.

Auto Awards  
Want to automatically award all BoE's to a specific person? RCLootCouncil will handle that for you! Disenchant unwanted items? Just click the "Disenchant" button in the Voting Frame and select the enchanter you want to do so.

Autopass  
If your class can't equip an item, simply enable auto passing and you won't have to bother rolling on that item.

Custom sessions  
If you for some reason want to add an item to a session, the group leader can do so using the  "/rc add" command. See commands below for more info.

And more  
In game synchronization of settings and history, modular extension, send notes to the council, plenty of automatization options, minimizing automatically in combat or manually, and more.

## Setup

Have every raid member install **RCLootCouncil** and the addon will handle the rest.

...

**RCLootCouncil** is ready to use right away, however there's a range of options available to those that wishes. From v2.0 all non Master Looter options is shown in the default options page (/rc config) while all Master Looter options are found when expanding **RCLootCouncil** to the left of the frame. The Master Looter options is applied to everyone in the raid, and only the current Master Looters options is used at any given time.

## Commands

_All commands are listed in [detail in the wiki](https://github.com/evil-morfar/RCLootCouncil2/wiki/Chat-Commands) ._

**prefix: /rc or /rclc**

* config or c - opens the options menu.
* open - opens the voting frame.
* council - displays the council options.
* version or ver - opens the version frame, good for testing whom has the addon installed.
* history or his - opens the loot history.
* whisper - shows a brief guide to how the whispers work.
* reset - resets the addon's frames' positions.
* test (number) - starts the addon in test mode.
Add number to test with a specific amount of items.
* sync - opens the synchronization window.
* trade - opens the TradeUI.
* profile - open the profile selection.
* add [item] - when ML, use this command followed by an item to add it to the session frame.
* award - when ML, use this to start a session with all items flagged as "Award Later".
* list - when ML this prints a list of all the items in your inventory handled by RCLootCouncil.
* remove (number(s)) - removes one or more items from the list, specified by it's index.
* clear - clears the list.

## Support

Want to support the development of RCLootCouncil and/or my other addons? Buy me a cup of coffee (I drink loads when programming) through Paypal or become a Patron.

[RCLootCouncil Paypal](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https%253a%252f%252fwww.paypal.com%252fcgi-bin%252fwebscr%253fcmd%253d_donations%2526business%253dJ2G4D8AHJVS5Y%2526item_name%253dRCLootCouncil) [](https://www.patreon.com/rclootcouncil)

## README.md

# Classic EPGP

**Do not redistribute this addon. Post a link to this github page instead**

An addon designed to handle your guild's EPGP standings by storing the respective values in your Officer Notes. Another primary function of the addon is to handle loot moderation which you must be the master looter to utilise.

For this addon to work, anyone using the addon must be able to at the very least view Officer Notes.
To adjust EP and GP values you must be able to edit Officer Notes.

The addon is entirely GUI based and the frame is designed to only appear automatically on raid bosses.

Functionality:

* Either /cepgp or /cep can be used as a valid command call
* show - Shows the cepgp window
* setdefaultchannel - Changes the default reporting channel. This is set to Guild by default
* version - Allows you to check if each raid member is running the addon - and if so, what version of the addon they are using

**Note: cepgp is a context sensitive addon and elements will be visible when they are relevent**

Any function that involves modifying EPGP standings requires you to be able to edit officer notes to have it available to you.

The following commands can be used to get EPGP reports.

**The player you whisper must be able to at least view officer notes**

* /w player !info - Gets your current EPGP standings
* /w player !infoguild - Gets your current EPGP standings and PR rank within your guild

# Less Time Managing  
More Time Playing

Detailed Guild Event Logging, Alt/Main Management, Member Bans, Additional Room for Member Notes, Mass Rank Management and Kick Tools, Inactivity Tracking, and much more.

## Why Use GRM?

Designed by a Guild Leader, for Guild Leaders.

### Better Guild Logging

Track joins, leaves, kicks, promotions, demotions, level ups, inactivity, note changes, birthdays, member anniversaries, and even name changes. Know exactly who did what and when.

Logging Screenshot

Click to expand

### Alt/Main Management

Identify alts and group them into an alt group with the ability to set 1 toon of the alt group as "Main." Mouseover any player in the roster to see their Main, their rank history, and all grouped alts.

Alts Screenshot

Click to expand

### Ban List System
Prevents banned players from sneaking back in. GRM alerts you if a banned player rejoins. Detects name-changes using GUID tracking (Permanent ID) to catch banned players even if they change their name.

Ban List Screenshot

Click to expand

### Secure Data Syncing

Decentralized database syncing keeps officers on the same page. Syncs Mains, Alts, Bans, Join Date, Rank Promotion Dates, and Custom Notes. Includes granular trust restrictions so only authorized ranks can sync critical data.

Sync Screenshot

Click to expand

### Macro Tool

A critical tool for large guilds. Quickly build macros to mass-kick inactive players based on your filters, or manage mass demotions and promotions efficiently.

Macro Tool Screenshot

Click to expand

### Custom Roster

A superior roster interface. Group members by their Main/Alt status and search public, officer, or custom notes instantly to find exactly who you are looking for.

Roster Screenshot

Click to expand

### Membership History
GRM stores the complete history of a player, including original join dates, leave dates, and rejoin dates. Tracks the date of _every_ promotion (or demotion) they have ever received, not just the last one.

History Screenshot

Click to expand

### Classic & Hardcore

Full support for Retail and all Classic versions (Expansion, Vanilla, and Anniversary). Hardcore mode support tracks perma-deaths and logs the exact time and date of the fallen.

Hardcore Screenshot

Click to expand

Enhance your LFG experience. This module informs you if you are grouped with former guildies, highlights current guildies you maybe have joined with and didn't realize it, and syncs known alt data to your party frames.

```
[Click here for short video explanation of the addon](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D7TUlJ91FOw)

**GRM DESIGN PHILOSOPHY**

Due to the nature of addons being restricted from connecting to the net, building a _decentralized_ database that is shared between other GRM users was required. As such, changes are only accepted by determining what was the most recent change and accepting it. In other words, you don't want a player who has been offline for a year to log back in and then sync outdated information to everyone. As such, all of it is timestamped and controlled.
Ultimately, this means that each individual GRM user has their own database, account-wide, including all servers and guilds they play on stored onto a single save file. This is _NOT_ a centralized database that other users can access. It is unique to you. While GRM includes some features that give the guild leadership the ability to unify some settings, so, for example, your officers don’t accidentally sync your ban lists to everyone, you still have full control to disable syncing and just use GRM your own way.

While most people are more likely to enjoy the benefits of syncing and sharing info among their guildies, I just want to make it clear that if you wish to use GRM in your own personal way within your own database, you can. No other GRM user can dictate how you use this addon.
While it is encouraged for you to actively participate in a meaningful way within your guild, ultimately so you can enjoy the rich features that GRM provides, there is no over-reaching hand that can come into your system and restrict your addon. That is the power that GRM provides. Ultimately, it is your addon, your account, and your data.

I just want to make it extremely clear that even though GRM provides a way to unify much of your database between other GRM users, there is no tyrannical hand forcing you to do so just by nature of having the addon installed. It is always your choice to participate.

* * *

# **Features Detailed In More Depth**

**DATA SYNCING**

Sync Details

_No need for every GRM user to configure all of these details, they will be sync'd both retroactively, and live. The more GRM users, the more redundancy in the guild if you lose your data and have no backups._

_**What Syncs:**_

```

* Alts
* Main Status
* Bans

The Same applies for player membership histories

Enhanced Guild Log

\-This log detects all of these as they occur _LIVE_ while you are playing, and it also reports on the events that occurred since you last logged in.

_**IMPORTANT: The Log is unique to each account and it is NOT synced between other GRM users. This is because your log is your own. Your filters are your own.**_

**BAN LIST**

\-Ban list is fully syncable to other users of the addon in your guild, and of course you can restrict the sync setting to just sync with other officer ranks.
